# @canopy/graphql

Canopy GraphQL API: a schema generated per role set from policies and collection schemas, with relations, subscriptions and limits.

`@canopy/server` mounts it at `/graphql/v1` from the same policies as REST and realtime; the config sets its limits.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/graphql @canopy/server
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { defineConfig, env } from "@canopy/config"

export default defineConfig({
  mongodb: { uri: env("MONGODB_URI") },
  graphql: { maxDepth: 8, introspection: "authenticated" },
  collections: {
    posts: { relations: { author: { to: "users", local: "authorId" } } },
  },
})
```
